description: Moves a consumer's <release>.pin.json to the newest immutable <release>-v<N> build of an asset-tooling rolling release (README "Following a release with Renovate"). Extend it as github>moritzbrantner/asset-tooling//renovate/asset-releases.

customManagers.description: The release name, the versioned tar URL and its sha256, in that order, as consumers.json pinFile entries write them.

packageRules.description: Every asset build is a new major version of its release; the consumer's own CI is the gate, so these merge on green without dashboard approval.
